feat(chat): Add "End Chat" functionality and confirmation dialog
This commit introduces a new feature allowing users to end a chat session. An "End Chat" button has been added to the chat screen, which, when tapped, presents a confirmation dialog to prevent accidental chat termination.
- **feat(chat):** - In `upper_view.dart`, a new "End Chat" `AppText` button has been added to the chat header. - Tapping the button displays a confirmation bottom sheet (`AppBottomSheet.large`) asking the user "Are you sure to end chat". - A new `alert.png` image is used in the confirmation dialog for visual emphasis. - Upon confirmation, a request is sent to the `ApiConstants.rejectAll` endpoint to terminate the chat. - After successfully ending the chat, the user is redirected to the home screen.
- **refactor(ui):** - In `upper_view.dart`, the layout has been changed from a `Stack` to a `Row` with `mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween` to better accommodate the new "End Chat" button alongside the existing report icon and timer/label. - The `AppText` widget has been enhanced to support `TextDecoration`.
- **i18n:** - Added new translation keys and their corresponding Arabic and English translations for "End Chat" (`end_chat`) and the confirmation message (`are_you_sure_to_end_chat`) in `lang.json`, `en.json`, and `ar.json`. - Updated `locale_keys.g.dart` to include the new translation strings.
- **build(ios):** - In `AppDelegate.swift`, removed Zego-related service setup code that is no longer needed in this file. - The project version in `project.pbxproj` has been incremented.
- **chore(dev):** - Added a new `gradleFix` command to the `Makefile` to help resolve Gradle lock file issues by stopping daemons and clearing lock files.
- **chore(assets):** - Added a new image `assets/images/alert.png`. - Regenerated `assets.dart` to include the new image asset.

refactor(home): Refactor opportunity fetching and Zego call handling
This commit refactors the home screen to use a dedicated Cubit for fetching opportunities, improving state management. It also includes several enhancements and fixes for Zego video calls and Android build configurations.
- **refactor(home):** - Created a new `GetOpportunitiesCubit` to handle fetching paginated opportunity data from the `/opportunities` endpoint. - In `main_screen/view.dart`, replaced the direct API call in `AppPagify` with a `BlocBuilder` that listens to `GetOpportunitiesCubit`. - The opportunities list is now built using a `Column` and `List.generate` based on the cubit's state, temporarily removing the pagination widget. - In `center_card_scaffold.dart`, changed `NestedScrollView` to `CustomScrollView` with `SliverFillRemaining` to better handle screen layout and scrolling.
- **fix(calls):** - In `zego.dart`, enabled `autoEnterAcceptedOfflineCall: true` to allow users to automatically join a call after accepting it from an offline state. - Re-enabled the `_handleOffline()` call to process offline call invitations.
- **build(android):** - In `MainActivity.kt`, changed the base class from `FlutterActivity` to `FlutterFragmentActivity` to better support plugins that use fragments. - Added new permissions (`SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM`, `USE_EXACT_ALARM`, `FOREGROUND_SERVICE_PHONE_CALL`) in `AndroidManifest.xml` to improve the reliability of call notifications. - Expanded `proguard-rules.pro` to include more comprehensive rules for Zego, Firebase, and Flutter to prevent code obfuscation issues in release builds.
- **chore(ide):** - Ignored changes in IDE configuration files (`.idea/workspace.xml`, `.claude/settings.local.json`, `.idea/caches/deviceStreaming.xml`).

This commit refactors the home screen's opportunity fetching logic by introducing a dedicated `GetOpportunitiesCubit`. feat(notifications): Add interactive chat request actions
This commit enhances the notification system to allow users to directly accept or reject new chat requests from the notification itself.
- **feat(notifications):** - In `notification_service.dart`, added interactive action buttons ("Accept", "Reject") to incoming new chat request notifications on Android. - Implemented `_handleActions` to process the user's choice. When an action is tapped, an API call is made to either `ApiConstants.acceptRequest` or `ApiConstants.rejectRequest`. - The logic correctly parses the necessary IDs (`user_request`, `match_request_id`, `sender_id`) from the notification payload to perform the action. - This allows users to respond to chat requests without opening the app, streamlining the interaction.
- **refactor(home):** - In `main_screen/view.dart`, the state management for the main screen's filters (`firstSelection` and `secondSelection`) has been lifted into a new `MainView` `StatefulWidget`. - This refactoring separates the state initialization from the `MainViewBody`, improving the structure and lifecycle management of the screen's filters.
- **chore(ide):** - Ignored changes in the IDE configuration file (`.idea/workspace.xml`).

feat(children): Add "Delete" functionality to child profiles
This commit introduces a "Delete" button on the `ParentChildrenCard`, allowing a parent to delete a child's profile. A confirmation dialog is shown to prevent accidental deletion.
- **feat(children):** - In `parent_children_card.dart`, a new "Delete" button (`DefaultButton`) has been added alongside the existing "Edit" button. - The card's layout is updated to a `Column` containing the `ListTile` and a `Row` for the action buttons, improving the structure. - Tapping "Delete" opens a `DeleteSheet` confirmation dialog, which asks "Are you sure to delete [child's name]".
- **i18n:** - Added new translation keys for "Delete" (`delete`) and the confirmation message (`are_you_sure_to_delete`) in `en.json`, `ar.json`, and `lang.json`. - Regenerated `locale_keys.g.dart` to include the new translation strings.
- **refactor(chat):** - In `chat_screen.dart`, the Zego call button is now conditionally rendered. It only appears if the chat stage is not `isNewChat`, preventing users from making calls in newly created chats.
- **fix(ui):** - In `app_pagify.dart`, the redundant `scrollController` property has been removed from the `Pagify` widget constructors, as it was not being used.
- **chore(ide):** - Ignored changes in the IDE configuration file (`.idea/workspace.xml`).

This commit enhances the Istikhara reminder functionality by introducing a separate "Istikhara Dua" (prayer) sheet that appears after the initial reminder. The underlying logic has been refactored to support fetching content from different API endpoints.
- **feat(chat):** - In `tips_action.dart`, after showing the `IstikharahRemindersSheet`, a second sheet is now shown to display the Istikhara Dua, creating a two-step reminder and prayer flow. - Created a new `IstikharaDuaCubit` to fetch the dua content from the `istikhara-dua` API endpoint. - A new `istikharaDua` endpoint has been added to `api_endpoints.dart`.
- **refactor(chat):** - `IstikharahReminderSheet` has been renamed to `IstikharahRemindersSheet` and now accepts a `path` parameter to fetch content dynamically (e.g., from `istikhara-reminder` or `istikhara-dua`). - `ReminderCubit` is updated to accept a `path` parameter in its `getReminder` method, making it reusable for fetching different types of reminders or content. - In `upper_view.dart`, the layout of the chat header has been adjusted. feat(notifications): Enable interactive chat actions on iOS
This commit extends the interactive notification feature, allowing users to accept or reject chat requests directly from the notification on iOS, in addition to the existing Android functionality.
- **feat(notifications-ios):** - In `notification_service.dart`, `DarwinNotificationCategory` is now configured to register "Accept" and "Reject" actions (`accept_chat`, `reject_chat`) for iOS notifications. - The `_showNotification` method now sets the `categoryIdentifier` for iOS to enable these actions on new chat requests. - The foreground notification presentation options for iOS are disabled to allow `flutter_local_notifications` to handle the display, ensuring action buttons appear. - In `AppDelegate.swift`, the necessary native code has been added to register the notification categories and actions with the `UNUserNotificationCenter`.
